sentences.en: Many a reader skips the words that he doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 很多读者会跳过不认识的单词。

sentences.en: This book is within the capacity of young readers.
sentences.zh: 这本书适合年轻人阅读。

sentences.en: This poem calls for great insight from the reader.
sentences.zh: 这首诗要求读者有深刻的见解。

senses.zh: 读者，朗读者,读本,讲读者，讲师,审稿人
